newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot propane gains ground on NYMEX coattails.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot propane gains ground on NYMEX coattails.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices edged higher at midday Thursday tracking higher crude oil prices in thin activity, players said.
"The market seems at an impasse; there are a lot of deals being talked but nobody is hitting," one Conway player said, as propane moved 0.25 cent higher to between 34.25 and 34.75 cents a gallon.
Mont Belvieu propane, meanwhile, was offered at 34.25 cents, also 0.25 cent higher.
Conway ethane slipped a half cent to offers of 13.50 cents a gallon, traders said, amid ample supplies.
